name: Sichuan Huafeng Technology Co., LTD.
summary: Sichuan Huafeng Technology Co., LTD. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of optical and electrical connectors and cable assemblies in China. Its products are used in communications, aviation, aerospace, shipbuilding, defense equipment, electronic equipment, nuclear power, new energy vehicles, rail transportation, low-altitude airspace, and other fields. Sichuan Huafeng Technology Co., LTD. was founded in 1958 and is based in Mianyang, China.
